rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and zip, matched to a single user, and only acted on that user’s orders. It inspected orders via read-only tools, identified the two pending orders, requested explicit confirmation and a reason, then executed cancellations only after confirmation. Tool outputs confirm both orders were cancelled and refunds initiated. The final message accurately reflected the cancellations and refunds. A minor note: the stated refund timeline (5–7 business days) wasn’t sourced from tools, but it’s a standard estimate and does not materially conflict with the tool results showing refunds issued. Overall, the interaction met policy requirements.
